0.comment: Shinobi World — Chronicle Gallery Image Contract
0.content:
[Shinobi World Chronicle gallery contract]
The optional Shinobi Chronicle Regex uses only the SW namespace and resolves portraits from Sillytavern/Shinobi World/Gallery/.

Use the exact binding from this lorebook:
[SWCHAR|filename.jpg|Exact Display Name|#HEX]
or, when village and rank are known:
[SWCHAR|filename.jpg|Exact Display Name|#HEX|Village|Rank]

Rules:
- Use only an exact filename listed in this lorebook/gallery registry.
- English and Thai keywords identify the same exact character form; do not combine aliases from different forms.
- Match the exact age, era, costume, title, status, and transformation.
- Never invent external URLs, Catbox IDs, base64 data, alternate filenames, or paths outside the Shinobi World Gallery.
- If no exact binding exists, use [SWNPC|Name|#HEX|Role] without an image.
- Keep machine markers on separate final lines and never narrate or quote them.

1.content:
[Shinobi World Chronicle output format]
Use only these namespaced markers. Do not emit generic [CHAR], [NPC], [SAY], or [THINK] markers when this optional pack is active.

Gallery portrait:
[SWCHAR|filename.jpg|Exact Display Name|#HEX]
[SWCHAR|filename.jpg|Exact Display Name|#HEX|Village|Rank]

NPC without a gallery match:
[SWNPC|Exact Name|#HEX|Role]

Spoken dialogue:
[SWSAY|#HEX|spoken words]
or:
[SWSAY|Speaker Name|#HEX|spoken words]

Inner thought:
[SWTHINK|Character Name|#HEX|inner thought]

Put every marker on its own final line after the natural prose. The marker is an invisible renderer instruction, not story text.
